title: Castelion news
description: A newsroom on the page colour: a big bold navy title with a red button at the right, then a page-wide 16:9 banner picture with a page-colour text box inset on its left (date, two-line headline, justified summary). Under a 2px navy rule, two rows of square picture + headline + two-column justified text on the left, and a tall card with a square picture on the right behind a vertical rule. Phones stack every post as square picture, date, headline and text between rules, with the button centred at the end. Posts rise into place as they scroll in.
notes: slots: one banner picture (16:9 on desktop, square on phones) and a square picture per post; empty they are muted surfaces
headlines are clamped to two lines, like the original
the aside card spans the left rows on desktop and sits after the first row on phones
